name: @qu/extensions
description: Qu V5: ExtensionPointHost - one ordered, id-addressable registry apps CONTRIBUTE into (a menu entry, a context-menu action, a piece of rendered chrome, an admin section) and framework/UI code RENDERS FROM, without either side importing the other. Three read shapes over the same registry: renderSlot() (every contributor mounts its own DOM into its own child container), collect() (gather every contributor's return value, e.g. a context menu's entries), renderFrom() (call exactly one named contributor). A contribution with no handler is a plain data entry (label/icon/href/order, resolveActionHref()'s own use case) - the SAME registry serves both the 'live code' and 'pure data' slot shapes V3 kept as two separate mechanisms, unified here into one.
